description_excerpt: Job Description Get to Know the Role We're looking for an experienced Lead Product Manager to join our Technical Infrastructure team, specifically focusing on the Data Platform. In this role, you will own the strategic direction and execution of our data platform, collaborating with engineering, data science, analytics, and product teams to identify areas for improvement and develop impactful solutions.
